_about: Phase 4. The ONLY change under test is the measured quantity: nearest visible surface vs rear extent along the wall normal. Same 48 cases, same labels, same MoGe-2 geometry, same SAM 2 masks, same wall planes, same 0.12 m threshold. All four variants share ONE geometry pass, so the walls are not merely equal across variants, they are the same objects.

frozen.rear_extent_percentile_rationale: Reused from Phase 3's percentile(|signed|, 10) with the projection reversed, rather than introducing a new hyperparameter. Frozen before the run.
frozen.orientation_rule: the side of the plane the room's median surface point lies on; the camera is not used

comparison.order: [A bbox+nearest, B SAM+nearest, C SAM+rear, D bbox+rear]

threshold_sweep_diagnostic.note: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. The threshold stays at 0.12 m for the gate.

percentile_sensitivity_diagnostic.note: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY, declared before the run. The gate uses the frozen percentile 10.0.
